Open Source Intel Veterans and recent service leavers on the U.K.'s Strategic Reserve, about 100,000 people, have been sent contact and readiness letters by the Ministry of Defence. It is the first outreach of its kind since the Cold War. The letters, signed by the chiefs of the Army, Navy and RAF, ask recipients to update their contact details and list their civilian jobs and skills.
